TB-03 / Read first

  • That one missing step is why you walked away with a report full of hard inquiries.
  • We review your file the way a lender does, before a single application goes out. That's pre-underwriting.
  • A red flag gets fixed first. Then your applications go only to the banks that fit your file.

TB-04 / Never

What we never do is in the agreement.

  • We never sign a loan or credit agreement for you, and we never accept funds for you.
  • We never make a false statement for you, and we never submit an inaccurate claim.
  • We never promise an approval or an amount.
  • If you got burned, you want to know what a company will never do with your file. Ours is written into the agreement.
  • Read it with me. Section 4: our authority does not let us sign a loan or credit agreement for you, accept funds for you, change your account, or make a false statement for you.
  • Section 6: we will not submit an inaccurate claim, and we will not stop you from making your own dispute.
  • Section 3: Fundhub does not promise approval, a funding amount, a lender rate, or a particular financial outcome. The bank decides.
  • A promise of an approval is a promise about what a bank does, and no company controls that.
  • Every application uses your true information, and every dispute names a real item on your report. That's how we work.
